question: Should OpenClaw make sibling `heartbeat.fallbacks` the public config API for heartbeat-specific fallback policy?
rationale: This creates a new operator-facing config/default surface and permanent fallback-policy contract; automation cannot choose the long-term API shape over the earlier object-form alternative.

options.title: Accept sibling heartbeat fallback keys
options.body: Proceed with `heartbeat.fallbacks`, preserving current behavior when unset and using `[]` as strict fail-fast policy after the docs formatting fix.

options.title: Switch to object-form heartbeat model
options.body: Ask for a rewrite that mirrors `{ primary, fallbacks }` on `heartbeat.model` instead of adding a sibling field.

options.title: Pause for broader fallback policy review
options.body: Hold the PR until heartbeat, cron, agent-primary, and session fallback policy are reviewed as one config design.

recommendation.title: Accept sibling heartbeat fallback keys
recommendation.body: Proceed with `heartbeat.fallbacks`, preserving current behavior when unset and using `[]` as strict fail-fast policy after the docs formatting fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the heartbeat config surface that commit 61e385b33163 introduced and this PR extends.
